supersedes.failure: preflight looked for the S01-3 contract outside its sealed inputs/contracts snapshot

input.source: sealed S01-2 token feature-row manifest; token IDs only during extraction
input.processing: single event per forward; exact length; no padding; no tokenizer; no mixed-length batch
input.test_split: S01-3 sealed grouped quartet bucket 0; no split changes

views.M: mean H_l across all model-visible positions [0, sequence_length)
views.serialization: little-endian float32 row-major matrix, shape [106496, 2048] per layer and surface
views.terminal_parity: layer 16 M/F arrays must be byte-identical to sealed S01-2 V0/V1 arrays over all events
views.repeat: first 256 sealed row indices, exact byte identity for all 16 layers and both surfaces

probe.fit_rows: S01-3 transfer fit mask: train quartet buckets 1-4, observation and query templates <6, context and entity terms TRAIN_SIDE_STYLE
probe.test_rows: all rows in S01-3 test quartet bucket 0; report all contracted exact-target conditions
probe.implementation: byte-identical copy of sealed S01-3 linear_core.py
probe.standardization: fit-only float64 population mean and standard deviation, zero scale becomes 1, transform to float32
probe.optimizer: torch.optim.LBFGS, zero initialization, intercept enabled/unregularized, mean cross entropy + 0.5*1e-4*sum(W^2), lr=1, max_iter=300, max_eval=375, tolerance_grad=1e-7, tolerance_change=1e-9, history_size=10, strong_wolfe
probe.terminal_gate_order: fit layer 16 M and F first; compare to sealed S01-3 probe states, scaler, probabilities, and metrics exactly; compare planes to S08 within 1e-7 degrees; only then fit layers 1-15

analysis.cross_transport: full donor scaler plus probe; no refit
analysis.subspace: S08 effective raw-coordinate pair normals, SVD rank tolerance max(shape)*float64_epsilon*sigma_max, principal angles, normalized squared-cosine overlap
analysis.depth_convergence: compare each same-surface plane with the sealed S08 layer-16 native plane
